(module asl-forms/repair
                                                                 
  :x [RepairedItem
      LeftItem
      RepairResult
      makeRepairedItem
      makeLeftItem
      makeRepairResult
      repairedItemKind
      repairedItemTok
      repairedItemLine
      repairedItemCol
      leftItemLine
      leftItemCol
      leftItemExpected
      leftItemNear
      repairResultText
      repairResultRepaired
      repairResultLeft
      repairResultReceipt
      formatReceipt
      repair
      repairText
      repairReceipt]
  :i [(asl-syntax/core/source :a src)
      (asl-syntax/core/tree :a tr)
      (asl-syntax/asl/paren :a prn)
      (asl-syntax/asl/layout :a lay)])

(schema RepairedItem
  (:f kind String)
  (:f tok String)
  (:f line Int64)
  (:f col Int64))

(schema LeftItem
  (:f line Int64)
  (:f col Int64)
  (:f expected String)
  (:f near String))

(schema RepairResult
  (:f text String)
  (:f repaired (List RepairedItem))
  (:f left (List LeftItem))
  (:f receipt String))

(schema EditOp
  (:f kind String)
  (:f start Int64)
  (:f end Int64)
  (:f tok String)
  (:f line Int64)
  (:f col Int64))

; (:m)                                       
fn makeRepairedItem kind: String tok: String line: Int64 col: Int64 -> RepairedItem
  (RepairedItem :kind kind :tok tok :line line :col col)

; (:m)                                   
fn makeLeftItem line: Int64 col: Int64 expected: String near: String -> LeftItem
  (LeftItem :line line :col col :expected expected :near near)

; (:m)                                       
fn makeRepairResult text: String repaired: (List RepairedItem) left: (List LeftItem) receipt: String -> RepairResult
  (RepairResult :text text :repaired repaired :left left :receipt receipt)

; (:m)                                   
fn repairedItemKind item: RepairedItem -> String
  item.kind    

; (:m)                                  
fn repairedItemTok item: RepairedItem -> String
  item.tok    

; (:m)                                   
fn repairedItemLine item: RepairedItem -> Int64
  item.line    

; (:m)                                  
fn repairedItemCol item: RepairedItem -> Int64
  item.col    

; (:m)                               
fn leftItemLine item: LeftItem -> Int64
  item.line    

; (:m)                              
fn leftItemCol item: LeftItem -> Int64
  item.col    

; (:m)                                   
fn leftItemExpected item: LeftItem -> String
  item.expected    

; (:m)                               
fn leftItemNear item: LeftItem -> String
  item.near    

; (:m)                                   
fn repairResultText res: RepairResult -> String
  res.text    

; (:m)                                       
fn repairResultRepaired res: RepairResult -> (List RepairedItem)
  res.repaired    

; (:m)                                   
fn repairResultLeft res: RepairResult -> (List LeftItem)
  res.left    

; (:m)                                      
fn repairResultReceipt res: RepairResult -> String
  res.receipt    

; (:m)                                    
fn escapeAsnString s: String -> String
  (let [(s1 (stringReplace s "\\" "\\\\"))
        (s2 (stringReplace s1 "\"" "\\\""))
        (s3 (stringReplace s2 "\n" "\\n"))
        (s4 (stringReplace s3 "\r" "\\r"))]
    s4)

; (:m)                                           
fn nearSnippet text: String s: src/Source line: Int64 col: Int64 -> String
  (mt (src/sourceLineStart s line)
    ((some start)
     (let [(end (src/sourceLineEnd s line))
           (lineStr (optionOr (stringSlice text start end) ""))
           (lineLen (stringLength lineStr))]
       (if (<= lineLen 60)
         lineStr
         (let [(startIdx (if (<= col 40)
                           0
                           (if (> (+ (- col 30) 60) lineLen)
                             (- lineLen 60)
                             (- col 30))))
               (sub (optionOr (stringSlice lineStr startIdx (+ startIdx 60)) ""))]
           sub))))
    ((none) ""))

; (:m)                                            
fn formatRepairedItem item: RepairedItem -> String
  (str "(:kind " item.kind     " :tok \"" (escapeAsnString item.tok    ) "\" :line " (stringFromInt64 item.line    ) " :col " (stringFromInt64 item.col    ) ")")

; (:m)                                        
fn formatLeftItem item: LeftItem -> String
  (str "(:line " (stringFromInt64 item.line    ) " :col " (stringFromInt64 item.col    ) " :expected \"" (escapeAsnString item.expected    ) "\" :near \"" (escapeAsnString item.near    ) "\")")

; (:m)                                                 
fn formatRepairedList items: (List RepairedItem) -> String
  (if (listEmpty? items)
    "()"
    (let [(n (listLength items))]
      (if (<= n 5)
        (str "(" (stringJoin (map formatRepairedItem items) " ") ")")
        (let [(first5 (listTake items 5))
              (rem (- n 5))]
          (str "(" (stringJoin (map formatRepairedItem first5) " ") " :more " (stringFromInt64 rem) ")")))))

; (:m)                                             
fn formatLeftList items: (List LeftItem) -> String
  (if (listEmpty? items)
    "()"
    (let [(n (listLength items))]
      (if (<= n 5)
        (str "(" (stringJoin (map formatLeftItem items) " ") ")")
        (let [(first5 (listTake items 5))
              (rem (- n 5))]
          (str "(" (stringJoin (map formatLeftItem first5) " ") " :more " (stringFromInt64 rem) ")")))))

; (:m)                                      
fn formatReceipt repaired: (List RepairedItem) left: (List LeftItem) -> String
  (str "(:repaired " (formatRepairedList repaired) " :left " (formatLeftList left) ")")

; (:m)                                     
fn applyEditOp text: String op: EditOp -> String
  (if (= op.kind     "delete")
    (let [(s op.start    )
          (e op.end    )
          (len (stringLength text))]
      (if (and (>= s 0) (<= s e) (<= e len))
        (let [(prefix (optionOr (stringSlice text 0 s) ""))
              (suffix (optionOr (stringSlice text e len) ""))]
          (str prefix suffix))
        text))
    (let [(s op.start    )
          (len (stringLength text))]
      (if (and (>= s 0) (<= s len))
        (let [(prefix (optionOr (stringSlice text 0 s) ""))
              (suffix (optionOr (stringSlice text s len) ""))]
          (str prefix op.tok     suffix))
        text)))

; (:m)                                          
fn applyEditOpsLoop text: String ops: (List EditOp) -> String
  (if (listEmpty? ops)
    text
    (let [(head (optionOr (listHead ops) (EditOp :kind "" :start 0 :end 0 :tok "" :line 0 :col 0)))
          (tail (optionOr (listTail ops) (list)))
          (nextText (applyEditOp text head))]
      (applyEditOpsLoop nextText tail)))

; (:m)                                
fn isAsnLang lang: String -> Bool
  (or (= lang "asn") (stringEndsWith? lang ".asn"))

; (:m)                                        
fn parseInLang text: String lang: String -> tr/Node
  (if (isAsnLang lang)
    (prn/parse text)
    (lay/parse text))

; (:m)                                       
fn langHasErrors root: tr/Node lang: String -> Bool
  (if (isAsnLang lang)
    (prn/hasErrors root)
    (lay/hasErrors root))

; (:m)                                         
fn langTreeErrors root: tr/Node lang: String -> (List tr/Node)
  (if (isAsnLang lang)
    (prn/treeErrors root)
    (lay/treeErrors root))

; (:m)                                      
fn editKeyForApply op: EditOp -> Int64
  (- 0 (+ (* op.start     10) (if (= op.kind     "delete") 1 0)))

; (:m)                                                 
fn editKeyForReport op: EditOp -> Int64
  (+ (* op.start     10) (if (= op.kind     "delete") 0 1))

; (:m)                                 
fn makeDeleteEditOp text: String s: src/Source d: tr/Delete -> EditOp
  (let [(start (tr/deleteStart d))
        (end (tr/deleteEnd d))
        (tok (optionOr (stringSlice text start end) ""))
        (posOpt (src/sourcePosAt s start))
        (line (mt posOpt ((some p) p.line    ) ((none) 1)))
        (col (mt posOpt ((some p) p.byteCol    ) ((none) 1)))]
    (EditOp :kind "delete" :start start :end end :tok tok :line line :col col))

; (:m)                                  
fn makeMissingEditOp s: src/Source m: tr/Missing -> EditOp
  (let [(off (tr/missingOffset m))
        (tok (tr/missingText m))
        (posOpt (src/sourcePosAt s off))
        (line (mt posOpt ((some p) p.line    ) ((none) 1)))
        (col (mt posOpt ((some p) p.byteCol    ) ((none) 1)))]
    (EditOp :kind "insert" :start off :end off :tok tok :line line :col col))

; (:m)                                      
fn editOpToRepairedItem op: EditOp -> RepairedItem
  (RepairedItem :kind op.kind     :tok op.tok     :line op.line     :col op.col    )

; (:m)                                              
fn leftItemKey item: LeftItem -> String
  (str (stringFromInt64 item.line    ) ":" (stringFromInt64 item.col    ) ":" item.expected    )

; (:m)                                               
fn dedupeLeftItems items: (List LeftItem) seen: (List String) acc: (List LeftItem) -> (List LeftItem)
  (if (listEmpty? items)
    (listReverse acc)
    (let [(h (optionOr (listHead items) (LeftItem :line 0 :col 0 :expected "" :near "")))
          (tail (optionOr (listTail items) (list)))
          (k (leftItemKey h))]
      (if (listContains? seen k)
        (dedupeLeftItems tail seen acc)
        (dedupeLeftItems tail (cons k seen) (cons h acc)))))

; (:m)                                           
fn collectLeftItems text: String s: src/Source nodes: (List tr/Node) acc: (List LeftItem) -> (List LeftItem)
  (if (listEmpty? nodes)
    (dedupeLeftItems (listReverse acc) (list) (list))
    (let [(n (optionOr (listHead nodes) (tr/makeErrorNode 0 0 (list))))
          (tail (optionOr (listTail nodes) (list)))
          (startOff (tr/nodeStart n))
          (posOpt (src/sourcePosAt s startOff))
          (line (mt posOpt ((some p) p.line    ) ((none) 1)))
          (col (mt posOpt ((some p) p.byteCol    ) ((none) 1)))
          (expected (mt (tr/nodeMissing n)
                      ((some m) (tr/missingTok m))
                      ((none) "")))
          (near (nearSnippet text s line col))
          (item (LeftItem :line line :col col :expected expected :near near))]
      (collectLeftItems text s tail (cons item acc))))

; (:m)                                            
fn repairLoop text: String lang: String depth: Int64 accRepaired: (List RepairedItem) -> RepairResult
  (let [(root (parseInLang text lang))]
    (if (not (langHasErrors root lang))
      (makeRepairResult text accRepaired (list) (formatReceipt accRepaired (list)))
      (if (<= depth 0)
        (let [(srcObj (src/sourceFromString "<input>" text))
              (errs (langTreeErrors root lang))
              (left (collectLeftItems text srcObj errs (list)))]
          (makeRepairResult text accRepaired left (formatReceipt accRepaired left)))
        (let [(srcObj (src/sourceFromString "<input>" text))
              (misList (tr/treeMissing root))
              (delList (tr/treeDeletes root))]
          (if (and (listEmpty? misList) (listEmpty? delList))
            (let [(errs (langTreeErrors root lang))
                  (left (collectLeftItems text srcObj errs (list)))]
              (makeRepairResult text accRepaired left (formatReceipt accRepaired left)))
            (let [(delOps (map (fn [(d tr/Delete)] -> EditOp (makeDeleteEditOp text srcObj d)) delList))
                  (misOps (map (fn [(m tr/Missing)] -> EditOp (makeMissingEditOp srcObj m)) misList))
                  (allOps (listAppend delOps misOps))
                  (sortedForApply (listSortBy editKeyForApply allOps))
                  (sortedForReport (listSortBy editKeyForReport allOps))
                  (newRepaired (map editOpToRepairedItem sortedForReport))
                  (nextRepaired (listAppend accRepaired newRepaired))
                  (nextText (applyEditOpsLoop text sortedForApply))]
              (repairLoop nextText lang (- depth 1) nextRepaired)))))))

; (:m)                                         
fn repairText text: String lang: String -> RepairResult
  (let [(root (parseInLang text lang))]
    (if (not (langHasErrors root lang))
      (makeRepairResult text (list) (list) "(:repaired () :left ())")
      (repairLoop text lang 4 (list))))

; (:m)                                          
fn repair text: String lang: String -> RepairResult
  (repairText text lang)

; (:m)                                               
fn repairReceipt text: String lang: String -> String
  (repairText text lang).receipt
